name: Colorful Box
source:
A "comical story" set in a school. You play as main character Narumi Morizuki who's been selected to work on the school festival committee. The game takes place over a one month period and has you interact with six different girls.

(from [url=http://uk.ps2.gamespy.com/playstation-2/colorful-box/]GameSpy[/url])
translation:
一部以校园为舞台的“喜剧故事”。玩家扮演主人公森月鸣海，他被选为学园祭执行委员。游戏时间跨度为一个月，期间将与六名不同的少女互动。

（摘自[url=http://uk.ps2.gamespy.com/playstation-2/colorful-box/]GameSpy[/url]）
